facts.value: Each descriptor is loaded into a runtime light chain and anims[0], when present, is attached. When prev is non-NULL, HSD_LObjSetNext replaces prev->next with curr; otherwise first is assigned curr. prev is then assigned curr. A NULL loaded head therefore makes the next iteration reset first; an empty table leaves first uninitialized. Non-NULL prior descriptor-chain tails may be disconnected by the direct next-pointer replacement.
facts.rationale: Correct inherited source/branch/section claim from pinned implementation.

facts.value: NULL root/output returns0. Requests terminate at-1; every other signed value consumes an output slot. Traversal descends unless INSTANCE, then follows siblings or ascends via parents. It stops at a NULL parent, not explicitly at the supplied root: an interior root can escape its subtree. Decreasing target relative to retained traversal position restarts at root; otherwise resumes. Negative targets other than-1 exhaust without matching; missing sentinel is not checked.
facts.rationale: Correct inherited source/branch/section claim from pinned implementation.

facts.value: Initializes and loads the caller texture from image fields. Exactly zero factor routes texture RGB through one stage; nonzero factor computes three RGB coefficient vectors and uses swap tables1-3 over three accumulating stages. The nominal factor1 matrix is approximately luminance times(1,0.9,0.8), assuming the expected swap-table definitions and target byte-conversion behavior. Factor is not clamped; alpha setup for stage0 remains the caller responsibility, while stages1/2 preserve prior alpha.
